title: Serve EUR main title cursor and separate animation bank
changes: Extend the layered OBJ resource with five four-row main-title cursor tables and a separate six-list, one-sequence title animation bank.
Retain E155 dataset compatibility and count main-title cursor reads separately.
validation: Wine e156-title-main-sources-wine-nexxapjy preserves the E155 projection, checks all 230 poisoned bytes and mixed boundaries, eleven original cursor cases including invalid language and uncapped row, and one original bank initializer/update. Three-frame interpreter/native-dispatch ordinary title pairs match state and clock with six typed cursor requests and zero raw reads per arm.
Wine e156-title-main-sources-cli-wine-813gyofb passes production CLI create/reuse/verify and one-frame startup with four main-title position bytes used; 102 unrelated files match E155.
limitations: The separate bank was not used in this ordinary window; its ordinary scene, other choices, per-read native attribution, frontend UI, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
